title: Reel three begins; bass in Ridgely's band at Suburban Gardens
summary: Williams names bassists he worked with in Ridgely's band, who played at Suburban Gardens in 1928.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: This is Real Three, Alfred Williams.
What about this bass with Ridgely when you were with it? Bass with Ridgely? Mm-hmm. Did he have one when you were with it?

Yeah, I'm not sure. Shots was with him a lot. Handy. Sills. David Jones. Mm-hmm. We played out the Suburban Garden. I was playing bass. Played out the Suburban Garden in 1928. Something else I wanted to ask you about.
